ON A CHROMOSOME NONE OF THEM HAD SEEN, THE WINNER IS THE PHYSICS AT +0.2852.
MECHANISM BEAT FITTING HERE. The physics carries no fitted parameters at all -- every
constant came from single-molecule measurements or from geometry -- and it still
transfers better than a network given a whole chromosome to learn from. That is the
argument for building the mechanism rather than regressing on the readout.
AND THE NETWORK DID NOT LEARN DIRECTION. Its orientation-shuffled twin scores
+0.1290 against +0.0893, so what it extracted was where CTCF binds, which was
already in its input. Loop extrusion is a claim about asymmetry and the network is not
making it.
